flash_691996.description: The UAE suspends all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran, citing regional escalations that threaten peace and security.

flash_691998.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announces sanctions against ICC President Tomoko Akane and senior lawyer Abdoulaye Seye. Netanyahu: The ICC has become a kangaroo court.

flash_691997.description:
Following the Israeli strike in Syria, a security source told Kan 11 News that Israel had recently sought to reach an understanding with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa through an indirect channel of communication. After the behind-the-scenes efforts failed, Israel provided the United States with intelligence indicating that Turkey was seeking to establish a presence at an airport in Syria, approximately 70 kilometers from the Israeli border. Israel argued that this constituted a violation of the understandings.

According to the source, after the talks failed and before Turkish forces arrived, Israel struck the Syrian base, where rehabilitation work had begun recently.

flash_692000.description: US envoy Tom Barrack says Israeli strikes in Syria highlight the need for Israel, Syria and Turkey to establish a mechanism to prevent escalation.

flash_691999.description: Lebanon's Al Mayadeen TV, which is affiliated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization, reported that the Israel Air Force carried out strikes on the outskirts of the town of Qantara, in the Ali Taher ridge area, and in the outskirts of Kfar Roummane in southern Lebanon.

flash_692003.description:
A 22-year-old electric scooter rider was seriously injured after crashing into a pole in Tel Aviv-Yafo.

Magen David Adom teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

flash_692002.description: President Trump is pushing aides to arrange a fall meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, seeking to revive stalled nuclear diplomacy, according to The Wall Street Journal.

flash_692001.description:
Two men were seriously and moderately injured in a shooting incident in Kafr Manda. Police have launched an investigation and are conducting searches for suspects.

According to police, the incident appears to be criminally motivated, and the circumstances are being investigated.

flash_692007.description: The US and South Korea are shortening joint military drills as Trump seeks renewed talks with Kim Jong Un and reportedly pushes for a fall meeting.

flash_692006.description: In an interview with Channel 12 News, Ambassador Mike Huckabee discusses Iran, Gaza, the US-Israel relationship and recent violence in Qusra.

flash_692005.description: Turkey rejects Israel's justification for strikes on Syria's Abu al-Duhur airbase, accusing Jerusalem of violating Syrian sovereignty and stability.

flash_692004.description: Anti-Israel progressive Angie Nixon defeats Alex Vindman in Florida's Democratic Senate primary, setting up a general election race against Ashley Moody.

flash_692009.description: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf accuses Washington of seeking concessions beyond the Iran deal as the 60-day talks deadline expires.

flash_692008.description: Bronx man accused of attacking worshippers and making antisemitic and racist remarks at Central Synagogue in Manhattan now faces federal hate crime charges.

flash_692010.description: Perhaps we should take a moment to examine the substance of the dispute between us, and perhaps then we will know how, at the very least, not to serve as oil on the fire.

flash_692013.description: Veteran Florida Democrat defeats crowded field after switching districts amid GOP-led redistricting effort, while facing criticism from Israel critics over her pro-Israel record.

flash_692012.description: The American guarantee Israel has leaned on for two generations has been publicly reranked below the price of gasoline by the man who may inherit the White House. Opinion.

flash_692011.description: In the non-democratic Middle East, Islamic/Arab regimes do not ascend to power through the ballot. They tend to be tenuous, as are their policies and agreements, which are not anchored in democratic and legal structures, but in foundational Islamic precepts and precedents. An historical review.

flash_692015.description: Sources close to Tehran tell the Financial Times Iran considering strikes on US assets in southeastern Europe, targeting undersea cables, if war renews.

flash_692017.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz rejected a promotion for Maj. Gen. Eliad Muati. Now, IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir has found a way to keep the senior officer in service.

flash_692016.description: Police forces raided Givat Ura Yisrael near Ariel, demolishing homes with belongings, religious books and children's items still inside.

flash_692014.description: The parents of Hillel Mordechai Dadon, the seven-and-a-half-year-old boy from Beit Shemesh who was brutally murdered by a neighbor, share their shock and grief at the incident.

flash_692018.description: New Kantar poll gives Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar! party 24 seats, narrowly ahead of Likud, while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc falls short of a majority.

flash_692020.description: MK Ahmed Tibi was barred from meeting Dr. Hossam Abu Safiya after security officials warned the visit could pose a security risk.

flash_692019.description: Police searching two warehouses in Jerusalem neighborhood uncover PLO flags, anti-Israel material, incitement signs, and hat identified with Hamas.

flash_692022.description: A new AI-powered platform launched in Savyon aims to make Jewish law, tradition and daily practices accessible worldwide, while connecting users with more than 1,000 rabbis.

flash_692021.description: IDF troops seal over two kilometers of Hamas terror tunnels beneath Gaza, as operations to dismantle the terrorist organization's underground network continue.

flash_692024.description: As the Jewish New Year approaches, rabbis weigh controversial plan to allow haredi draft evaders barred from leaving Israel to make the pilgrimage.

flash_692023.description: A day after extremists attacked his hasidim in Jerusalem, the Karlin-Stolin Rebbe praises their resolve, but warns 'use of force is not the way of the Torah.'

flash_692031.description: IDF strikes commander in Hamas' military wing who infiltrated Israel on October 7th. A short time later, the military eliminated a second commander who planned to attack IDF troops.

flash_692030.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir visits IDF positions in southern Syria following strike on Syrian airbase to prevent planned Turkish military deployment.

flash_692029.description: British broadcaster's highest complaints panel rejects complaint over phrase referencing well-known Jewish family in decision called 'beyond compregension.'

flash_692027.description: A Jewish newspaper in Jerusalem propped up inflated charges of settler violence charges as unquestionably true, handing our declared enemies the one asset they cannot manufacture for themselves. Why does it continue to print the blood libel it has already debunked?

flash_692025.description: Israeli security forces uncovered firearms, ammunition, pipe bombs, and a hand grenade in a series of raids across Judea and Samaria, arresting a Palestinian man in his 50s.

flash_692033.description:
The chairman of the Central Elections Committee, Justice Noam Sohlberg, ordered Together party leader Naftali Bennett on Wednesday to remove footage of soldiers engaged in operational activity and an IDF artillery cannon from an election campaign video.

In the video, Bennett refers, among other things, to soldiers who have been fighting for months while Haredim evade military service. As he discusses the soldiers, the footage appears in the background. The Likud Party argued that this constituted the use of public assets and the IDF for election campaigning, in violation of the law.

flash_692032.description: IDF reviews examine WCK strike, deaths of Hind Rajab and MSF employees, and Tel al-Sultan incident; criminal investigations ordered in two of them.

flash_692028.description: Palestinian Red Crescent: Seven dead 15 wounded in strike on Gaza City police station

flash_692026.description: 'Together' chairman Naftali Bennett blasts 'Yashar!' chair Gadi Eisenkot's haredi draft plan and its 30% exemption proposal: 'We know exactly how it ends: with nothing.'

flash_692036.description:
The Lebanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants strongly condemned the Israeli airstrikes that targeted Abu al-Duhur Military Airport in Idlib Governorate on Tuesday. The Ministry stated that it considers these strikes a "blatant violation of the sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity of the Syrian Arab Republic, as well as a clear breach of international law and the Charter of the United Nations."

The Ministry reaffirmed Lebanon's "firm support for Syria's sovereignty, security and stability, and stresses Lebanon's rejection of any attack on Syrian territory. It further underscores the need to put an end to these violations and refrain from any steps that could heighten tensions and threaten regional stability."

flash_692035.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir clashed with a resident during a police tour of Basmat Tab'un, then praised a local driver's support for Israel.

flash_692034.description: Boaz Melet tells Arutz Sheva how his son Benayahu, who was shot in a terrorist attack, recovered and continued fighting the terrorists until his final moments.

flash_692040.description: IDF details scope of humanitarian response in Gaza since October 2025 ceasefire, says some 600 trucks enter daily and hospital bed capacity has increased by more than 50%.

flash_692039.description: Karmei Oz and Sahlab received official locality codes, completing years-long recognition processes and enabling expanded services and development.

flash_692038.description: Justice Noam Sohlberg ruled that footage showing soldiers and an IDF artillery piece constitutes use of public assets and ordered Naftali Bennett to remove it.

flash_692046.description: IDF identifies four Nukhba commanders eliminated in a northern Gaza strike, including an October 7 infiltrator and three involved in attacks on troops.

flash_692045.description: Shalom Leon, who immigrated to Israel before the Holocaust, passed away at Ichilov Hospital. His funeral will take place Thursday in Givatayim.

flash_692044.description:
The Health and Environmental Protection Ministries announced that mosquitoes carrying the West Nile virus were detected in the areas of Petah Tikva, Kafr Qasim, Kafr Bara, Ben Gurion Airport, and the Brenner and Central Arava regional councils.

Since the beginning of the season, 17 people have been diagnosed with the virus. One person has died, while another remains hospitalized.

flash_692043.description:
The wildfire near the community of Afeka in the Southern Hebron Hills continues to spread rapidly through woodland and open areas.

Four firefighting aircraft are operating to contain the blaze before it reaches residential homes, while additional support teams are on their way to the scene. Highway 60 in the area of the fire has been closed to traffic in both directions.

flash_692042.description: LTG Eyal Zamir tours security zone in southern Syria, warns escalation could develop on any front and praises reservists who have served hundreds of days since the war began.

flash_692041.description: Trump says he will meet with Kim Jong Un later in the year

flash_692037.description:
Firefighters and volunteers are working to contain a wildfire that broke out near the community of Afeka in the southern Hebron Hills.

The Israel Fire and Rescue Authority said a large fire is advancing through woodland toward residential homes, driven by strong winds. Firefighting aircraft and additional crews have been dispatched to the scene.

flash_692048.description:
Following the strikes earlier today (Wednesday), the IDF and ISA struck a gathering of terrorists in a police station in the Tuffah area of the northern Gaza Strip. During the strike, at least four terrorists from Hamas' military wing were present, alongside another terrorist from the military wing of the Popular Resistance Committees terrorist organization. The IDF will provide further updates on the result of the strike when possible.

The IDF emphasized that the terrorists who were struck operated from a civilian police station to advance terror attacks against IDF troops in the Gaza Strip, while using it for military purposes and against international law.

Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians.

Half an hour before then, a platoon commander from the Hamas terrorist organization, who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7th Massacre, was eliminated. The IDF will provide further updates on his terror activity when possible.

flash_692047.description: Fire near Afeka in the Southern Hebron Hills under control

flash_692052.description: After ten years together, 505 days during which Eliya Cohen was held hostage, and a prolonged struggle to bring him home, he and Ziv Abud are getting married tonight.

flash_692051.description: Mossad chief Roman Gofman reportedly spoke with Syria’s foreign minister days before Israel struck an airbase, warning against Turkey’s military presence.

flash_692050.description: Judge Nasser Abu Taha, who became Israel’s first Bedouin judge, has requested to relocate from his home in southern Israel to the north and serve there following threats.

flash_692054.description: A 19-year-old new driver was arrested after allegedly reaching 201 km/h on Route 60, shutting off his lights and trying to flee police.

flash_692053.description: If a white supremacist accused Jews of bribing members of Congress, no synagogue would invite him as a speaker. New York's oldest Reform Jewish congregation is hosting a newspaper columnist who has made that exact same accusation. Opinion.

flash_692049.description: Israel reportedly demands the return of Israeli prisoners’ remains as talks with Lebanon continue, with Hezbollah refusing to leave a key southern Lebanon position.

flash_692057.description:
Bereaved families from the Gevurah Forum have launched a campaign against negotiations with senior Hamas officials, amid Jared Kushner’s visit to Israel and contacts being held by representatives of the Trump administration.

The bereaved families distributed advertisements under the headline, “You fight terrorism, you don’t talk to it," sharply criticizing Kushner for engaging in talks with the organization’s leadership.

The campaign prominently features Khalil al-Hayya, a senior Hamas official and one of the key figures in the organization’s leadership involved in the negotiations currently underway.

flash_692056.description:
The funeral of Staff Sgt. Yehuda Yekutiel Katz, who fell in the Battle of Sultan Yacoub and whose remains were returned to Israel this week, will be held on Friday.

The funeral procession will depart from Kerem B’Yavneh Yeshiva and proceed to the military section of the cemetery on the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem.

flash_692055.description: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu was asked by his son, Minister Amichai Eliyahu, whether the judicial reform should be abandoned in favor of a unity government.

flash_692059.description: At an event marking the dedication of a memorial and study room for Israel’s fallen soldiers, the Chief Rabbi shakes Gadi Eisenkot’s hand and tells him, “You are a source of inspiration."

flash_692058.description: Representatives of Hadash, Ta’al and Balad agree to run together in the upcoming elections. Ra’am will not be part of the alliance.

flash_692061.description: President Trump says the Hormuz blockade is "100% successful" as negotiations with Iran remain stalled and warns Tehran could face severe sanctions.

flash_692060.description:
Hapoel Be’er Sheva defeated Azerbaijan’s Sabah 2-1 and is now just 90 minutes away from reaching the Champions League for the first time in the club’s history.

Javon East and Igor Zlatanović scored to complete the comeback against the Azerbaijani champions.

flash_692063.description: President Trump announces an unprecedented economic campaign against Iran, threatening severe consequences for countries and businesses that aid Tehran.

flash_692062.description:
The death toll from the earthquake that struck Colombia last week has risen to 314, President Abelardo de la Espriella announced.

According to the president, 262 people are still reported missing.

flash_692067.description: Left-wing activists hang a sign calling for the establishment of a Palestinian state without authorization. Dizengoff Center removes it and calls police.

flash_692066.description:
A man in his 60s was critically injured and in unstable condition after falling from a balcony approximately four meters above the ground in Jerusalem.

United Hatzalah teams provided him with initial medical treatment before he was evacuated to the hospital.

flash_692065.description: Prince Harry and Meghan are preparing to move back to the UK later this month, according to British media, with their children set to attend a British school in September.

flash_692064.description:
Magen David Adom (MDA) confirmed that a man in his 50s who had been missing for several hours was found dead at the National Park Beach in Ashkelon.

MDA medical teams pronounced him dead at the scene.

flash_692070.description: Syrian FM Asaad Al-Shaibani tells Axios that Israel struck Abu al-Duhur airbase despite assurances Syria had no plans for a permanent Turkish military presence.

flash_692069.description: US forces have established a secret Hormuz shipping corridor moving millions of oil barrels daily, according to an Axios report.

flash_692072.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband condemns Israel's E1 construction tender and demands it be withdrawn, warning it threatens the two-state solution.

flash_692071.description: Israel's UN Ambassador Danny Danon calls for Security Council reforms, says emergency meetings have become a political tool repeatedly used against Israel.

flash_692068.description: Australia's Foreign Minister says she is "outraged" and will summon the Israeli envoy after Israel ruled out a criminal probe into 2024 Gaza strike that killed Australian aid worker and six colleagues.

flash_692073.description: President Trump confirms he plans to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un this year, reviving diplomacy after three previous summits failed to yield a deal.

flash_692074.description: Religious Services Ministry officials were ordered to prepare for the Cave of the Patriarchs' closure within 14 days amid a funding shortfall.

flash_692079.description: Three suspects face indictment for the double murder in Buq'ata after police uncovered an alleged hit squad targeting a man over protection money.

flash_692078.description: A person should be able to declare, without embarrassment or apology: I am hareidi. I work. I serve. I support my family. I care about my country. And I still belong in my community. A new hareidi political movement is promoting just that.

flash_692076.description: Hezbollah-affiliated Al-Akhbar reports Houthis preparing for possible escalation with Saudi Arabia, including renewed fighting along Saudi Arabia's southern border.

flash_692081.description: Border Police uncover concealed compartment at Jerusalem-area crossing, finding 16 illegal infiltrators packed inside.

flash_692080.description: How a popular children’s TV personality, with a huge following, deliberately manipulates innocent, young minds against Israel. It must stop. Op-ed.

flash_692077.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan against dragging country into 'dangerous adventures' in Syria.

flash_692075.description: Gaza is hot now. That means everyone wants to be the new Gaza, which, if the real Gaza is anything to go by, means fat people in fake blue press vests doing TikTok videos claiming that they’re about to starve unless Israel or America surrender to them. Opinion.

flash_692086.description: Israel and Colombia scrap visa requirements beginning September 1, in the latest sign of rapidly warming ties between the two countries.

flash_692085.description: Report: President Donald Trump has ordered his Iran negotiating team to freeze talks for several weeks as prospects for a deal with Tehran diminish.

flash_692084.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar rejects Britain's criticism over E1, accusing London of 'one-sided' policy against Israel.

flash_692082.description: Jerusalem’s Green Line begins service Friday, linking the city center to Malcha with 12 new stops, while a key stadium station stays closed during events.

flash_692089.description: Prime Minister's Office denies authorizing the International Stabilization Force to enter Gaza and reiterates that reconstruction will not begin until Hamas fully disarms.

flash_692088.description: Woman in her 40s, 34 weeks pregnant, dies following a rare complication and sudden deterioration; hospital reports case to Health Ministry.

flash_692087.description: Al-Arabiya correspondent reports from front line of fighting between the government and Houthi terrorist rebels in eastern Yemen, as government forces fight off drones in the background.

flash_692083.description: Palestinian Arabs claim 'settlers' torched building with family inside, police investigators prove allegations utterly baseless.

flash_692093.description: The Tur on the Laws of Rosh Hashanah wrote: "Therefore the Sages established that the shofar should be blown on the first day of Elul every year and all through the month..."

flash_692092.description: Israel Police seek the public's help locating 23-year-old Amir Amberber of Ramla, who has been missing since arriving in Japan on August 2.

flash_692090.description: Man is a soul sent into the world to serve God. Therefore, all of his powers are necessarily enlisted in this plan.

flash_692096.description: Police suspect Rahat resident married 10 women over the years, including five non-Israeli residents, and harbored women staying in Israel illegally.

flash_692095.description: US Embassy delegation visits Israel’s Upper Galilee to explore economic cooperation, investment, trade and regional development following the war.

flash_692094.description: Ground service workers halt passenger handling during the busiest travel period of the year, with nearly 100,000 passengers passing through the airport daily.

flash_692091.description: IDF troops simulate simultaneous attacks, mass-casualty incidents and threats to Israeli communities in major exercises focused on northern Samaria.

flash_692103.description: The Prime Minister addressed the surprise strike and severe disruptions at Ben Gurion Airport and made clear that the airport would operate normally.

flash_692102.description: Senior official warns Supreme Court justices they will bear responsibility if the funding crisis leads to disaster at crowded holy sites during Selichot and the High Holidays.

flash_692101.description: IDF intelligence reveals Hamas is allegedly using Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis as an interrogation and torture center as the terrorist organization fears losing its grip over Gaza residents.

flash_692100.description: Note: The parapet around the roof of a house protects the house. “You shall not place blood in your house": inside the house - inside the national home - must be a safe place.

flash_692099.description: Where is the real Western Wall?

flash_692098.description: Because of the closeness to his family, a person ometimes allows himself to speak ill of his wife, husband, children, uncles, and other relatives. This is an unfortunate error.

flash_692097.description: Ground service workers halt passenger handling during the busiest travel period of the year, arrivals grind to complete stop.

flash_692109.description: The body of Katriel Nachman Keinan, 24, from Beit Shemesh, was found in difficult terrain in the area of the Switzerland Forest in Tiberias after more than a week of searches.

flash_692108.description: The US ambassador to Israel defends direct talks with Hamas, saying Kushner delivered a blunt message: disarm, demilitarize and accept that they would need to leave Gaza.

flash_692107.description: A summary of a Torah lesson written by Yehuda Katz in his youth takes on chilling significance.

flash_692106.description: Firefighters race to rescue eagle owl trapped in bird net, racing against time and the risk of dehydration and deterioration.

flash_692105.description: The Torah's lesson is one Israel learned tragically on October 7: Do not mistake quiet for a permanent change in the intentions of those who wish us harm.

flash_692104.description: It is painful to note that, today, the degree of assimilation in the USA is such that, in the not distant future, the once robust American Jewish community will be a shell of its former self.

flash_692111.description: New York police were called to the scene following a report from Shomrim volunteers, arrested the suspects for questioning, and led them away from the scene in handcuffs.

flash_692110.description: At Ben Gurion Airport, the baggage conveyors are back in operation, and the check-in counters have reopened.

flash_692112.description: The High Court of Justice unanimously accepted the petitions against the government’s decision to shut down the military radio station

flash_692114.description:
IDF humanitarian delegation teams in Colombia, working alongside local rescue forces, located and rescued all missing people at the impact sites in which they operated and continue to assist at other impact sites.

In addition, the delegation’s members continue a central effort to assess buildings and conduct professional surveys of damaged structures, in order to assist decision-makers in the city in developing an up-to-date situational assessment. In this way, the delegation’s experts are enabling educational and healthcare institutions to resume operations, allowing the city to return to normal functioning as soon as possible.

To date, dozens of buildings have been surveyed; most have been approved for use, while some have been deemed unsafe. Just yesterday, the delegation’s experts approved the safe return of more than 250 families to their homes.

flash_692113.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee lays out the true effects of violent extremism in Judea and Samaria in an exclusive interview with Arutz Sheva.

flash_692116.description: Sheikh Muhammad Ali al-Fouani accuses Iran of brainwashing the disadvantaged population and claims that international pressure would lead to Hezbollah’s rapid collapse.

flash_692115.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called on Gadi Eisenkot to clarify his positions regarding interference by foreign countries, continued construction in Judea and Samaria, and the establishment of a Palestinian state.

flash_692119.description: The city that saw the towers fall under the weight of planes piloted by men who invoked Allah has elected a mayor who bows to the same cultural tradition that speaks the language of those who, in other latitudes, consider the West an enemy. Opinion.

flash_692118.description: Senior Israel Airports Authority officials claim that workers’ committee chairman Pinchas Idan planned to disrupt the Transportation Minister’s flight to Morocco, but ultimately postponed the strike by one day.

flash_692117.description: Regavim warns illegal scrapyards are fueling car theft and security threats after the Supreme Court accepts the state’s claim that sufficient enforcement measures have been taken.

flash_692122.description: UK, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Canada and Norway condemn the E1 tenders, warning they could damage the two-state solution and Israel's international standing.

flash_692121.description: MK Meir Porush threatened to use the sector’s purchasing power, estimated at tens of billions of shekels, if what he described as the “persecution of the Haredim" continues.

flash_692120.description: Families bereaved on October 7 accuse supporters of a state commission of inquiry of seeking a political outcome, demanding an independent panel with coalition and opposition agreement.

flash_692124.description: In a special Arutz Sheva interview, US Ambassador Mike Huckabee speaks out on Iran, Hamas, Syria, Israel's upcoming elections, and Trump-Netanyahu ties.

flash_692123.description: Shas chairman launches the party’s election campaign with harsh accusations against elements within the Haredi community who, he claims, are acting on behalf of the left to harm the right-wing bloc.

flash_692127.description: Prime Minister speaks with the singer during her concert: “It’s wonderful to be with our amazing people and with you."

flash_692126.description: Netanyahu’s associates furious over the move by Pinchas Idan, chairman of the Israel Airports Authority workers’ union, prompting the Prime Minister to order his removal from Likud.

flash_692125.description: From war and the struggle with the enemy to marriage, education and mutual responsibility: a journey through the three circles of the Jewish soul.

flash_692129.description: Albany woman charged after allegedly plotting an ISIS-inspired attack on New York's Capitol and seeking explosives and a gun.

flash_692128.description:
Hapoel Tel Aviv on Thursday evening played to a 0-0 draw away to Italian side Atalanta in Bergamo in the first leg of the Conference League playoff round.

Meanwhile, Maccabi Tel Aviv lost 2-1 to Lugano in Switzerland and will need to win the second leg next week to overturn the deficit and advance to the league phase of the competition.

flash_692131.description: Some 50,000 people attend second Selichot service at the Western Wall, praying for the safety of IDF soldiers and the security of Israel.

flash_692130.description:
Dozens of extremist haredim protested at the Maccabim Checkpoint near Modi’in, in protest of the arrest of a draft evader.

The evader was detained by police near the Beit Gamzu Junction and was later transferred to Military Police custody.

flash_692136.description: The US imposes new sanctions on Hezbollah over its ties to Iran's Quds Force and sanctions 10 people accused of helping move cash for the Lebanese terror group.

flash_692135.description:
Lebanese media reported early Friday morning that the Israel Air Force carried out strikes in the town of Mansouri and in the Ali al-Taher ridge area in southern Lebanon.

Later, two additional strikes were reported in Duhayra and Kfar Rouman in southern Lebanon.

flash_692133.description: Jay Shapiro examines the unique continuity of the Jewish nation, its connection to Jerusalem, and the persistence of antisemitism throughout history.

flash_692141.description: The Trump administration plans to again bar PA chairman Mahmoud Abbas from entering the US for the UN General Assembly, Israeli media reports.

flash_692140.description: Finding holiness where you least expect it.

flash_692139.description: The war of conquest against the West involves both Iran and the Muslim Brotherhood. Opinion.

flash_692138.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is currently holding discussions ahead of the appointment of a new interior minister and is expected to make a decision soon, following nearly a year in which the ministry has operated without a permanent minister. Kan 11 News reported.

According to the report, the appointment will be coordinated with Shas chairman Aryeh Deri, who is expected to approve only a candidate acceptable to him. Leading candidates include Coalition Chairman Ofir Katz, Ministers Miki Zohar and Yariv Levin, and Interior Ministry Director-General Israel Ouzan.

flash_692137.description: The EU is preparing sanctions against Israel if construction proceeds in E1, including possible trade, academic, security and diplomatic measures.

flash_692134.description:
A terrorist armed with a knife attempted to stab an IDF soldier during IDF operational activity in the Jenin area.

The soldiers responded by firing toward the terrorist and eliminating him. No IDF injuries were reported.

flash_692132.description:
Italian media reported that 45 kilograms of smoke grenades and fireworks were found in the rented apartment of two Hapoel Tel Aviv fans who were arrested shortly before the team’s match in Bergamo.

According to the reports, Italian special forces and intelligence officers took part in the raid on the apartment.

flash_692144.description: Here comes Elul: Primal urges or the spirit of prophecy?

flash_692143.description: US Vice President JD Vance says the Iran war has entered a new phase, with Washington relying on economic pressure to prevent Tehran from rebuilding.

flash_692145.description: Yashar! surges to 26 seats as Likud falls to 20, while the center-left bloc reaches 60 seats, just one short of a Knesset majority.

flash_692147.description: Family, friends and fellow yeshiva students gather to accompany Yehuda Yekutiel Katz to his final resting place, 44 years after he went missing in the Battle of Sultan Yacoub.

flash_692146.description: Passengers face major delays, hours-long baggage waits, as fallout from the airport strike continues into Friday morning.

flash_692142.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul urges Mayor Zohran Mamdani to focus on city government rather than Israel amid concerns over his anti-Israel rhetoric.

flash_692148.description: Solomon's Pools takes a major step toward opening to the public, offering visitors a rare look at the ancient system that supplied Jerusalem during the Second Temple period.

flash_692154.description: Turkey under Erdogan is not a democratic bridge between East and West, nor is it a reliable pillar of transatlantic security; it is an expansionist, authoritarian power fundamentally hostile to democratic governance, Western values, and the existence of Israel in the Middle East. Another wake up call. Opinion.

flash_692153.description: 'Democrats' MK Gilad Kariv says party not competing with Arab parties for voters, insists strong Arab representation important for Israeli democracy.

flash_692152.description: Developments suggest that Turkey is gradually acquiring the ability to project naval power across two strategically important maritime theaters: the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. Israel must plan its next steps. Opinion.

flash_692151.description: Hamas commander Sabahi Sami Mahmoud Shahata, who participated in the October 7 massacre and held multiple hostages in captivity, eliminated in IDF strike in Nuseirat.

flash_692150.description: The manner in which we confront the wiles of the yetser ha’ra in its efforts to subvert our avodat Hashem, is the true measure of our service of our Creator.

flash_692149.description: Police reveal the identity of 26-year-old man suspected of stabbing two young cousins as they played in a pool, killing seven-year-old Hillel Mordechai Dadon.

flash_692157.description:
A group of Jews touring in eastern Gush Etzion entered an Arab village a short time ago, and was attacked with rocks.

IDF forces were called to the scene to extract the hikers.

flash_692156.description: Joint Arab List leaders meet European Union ambassadors in Tel Aviv, urging greater European involvement in Israel and presenting allegations over government policy and Arab representation.

flash_692159.description: Dozens of Arab rioters hurl rocks at Jewish hikers who apparently entered village by mistake; security forces rush to rescue the group.

flash_692158.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan defends party's 'massive campaign' targeting Arab voters, vowing Jews and Arabs will work together to replace government.

flash_692155.description: Dealing with children who derail your life.

flash_692163.description: Isaiah’s message was one of consolation, but also of responsibility.

flash_692162.description: We are not just a united nation. We are a nation of one, so interconnected that we are like a single person. A look at the parasha's topics shows it.

flash_692161.description: Is this a bad or a good thing? And who is behind the initiative? Some are against the idea of flying in to vote and leaving again, some are afraid there is only one type of voter being helped to fly in to vote.

flash_692164.description: Days after Israeli flags were vandalized near Rawabi, activists restore them and add dozens more: 'For every flag that was vandalized, we put up another.'

flash_692169.description:
Several people were injured in an attack at a school in Sweden by a man armed with a sword, according to local media reports.

Further details about the circumstances of the incident have not yet been released.

flash_692168.description: Ankara asks Interpol to issue arrest warrants for Netanyahu and dozens of senior Israeli officials over their alleged involvement in stopping the Global Sumud flotilla en route to Gaza.

flash_692167.description:
The Israel Airports Authority announced that operations at Ben Gurion Airport have stabilized and returned to normal. The flight schedule is operating as usual, and terminal operations are taking place without delays.

Luggage that had not been sent abroad has been sorted and transferred to the airlines, while baggage belonging to passengers who landed but did not receive it is being delivered to them by the airlines.

flash_692173.description: What is chutzpah? A Jew pouring a foundation in his ancestral homeland who gets a summons, a sanctions package, a joint communiqué with six other governments and a threat to label his tomatoes. Opinion.

flash_692172.description:
An individual who, according to the IDF, crossed the yellow line in southern Gaza and approached Israeli troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat was neutralized by soldiers from the Givati Brigade.

The IDF said Southern Command forces remain deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue operating to eliminate any immediate threats.
